caption:
She said “three.” He heard “maximum.”

A small user story became a hard product limit. The AI assistant turned that misunderstanding into validation, an error message and tests.

An example isn’t a maximum. Make that clear to people and AI.

AI Augmented Development Pitfalls · 01
AI-generated scenes and voices.
